headline: UK Household Energy Bills to Surge 26% in January on Gas Price Spike
summary: Energy bills will soar by 26% for millions of UK households in January following a surge in gas prices driven by the Iran war.
why: Higher household energy costs increase inflationary pressures and reduce consumer discretionary spending, impacting the broader UK economy.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: A broad surge in regulated energy bills raises cost-of-living metrics across the country.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Spiking wholesale gas prices driven by geopolitical conflict directly feed into higher retail energy price caps for consumers.
